items.name: Paneer Butter Masala

items.description: Cubes of paneer marinated in spices and yogurt, grilled to perfection. Served with mint chutney.

items.name: Gulab Jamun
items.description: Soft milk-solid dumplings soaked in rose-flavored sugar syrup. A classic Indian dessert.

items.name: Aloo Gobi

items.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with fresh vegetables, saffron, and aromatic spices. Served with raita.
